articles.title: BioWare Can Never Die: It’s Everywhere You Look - IGN
articles.summary:
BioWare doesn’t need a eulogy: as private equity and corporate consolidation shutters yet another legendary creative institution, the social media has naturally flooded with obituaries for the studio behind Mass Effect, Dragon Age, and Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic. But you cannot kill BioWare by filing some legal paperwork: it is the foundational DNA of modern interactive storytelling, and massively influential in the wider world of culture, seeping into everything from Star Trek to The Expanse. BioWare has attained a level of mortality that most storytellers can only dream of: by outliving its corporate shell and quietly conquering an entire medium.
BioWare's design philosophy continues to drive the biggest RPGs, and more besides. Its spiritual successors include Archetype Entertainment’s sci-fi epic Exodus (helmed by Drew Karpyshyn and James Ohlen), Casey Hudson’s Star Wars: Fate of the Old Republic at Arcanaut Studios, Mike Laidlaw’s Eternal Strands, and David Gaider’s Stray Gods. BioWare’s cinematic dialogue systems, Aurora Engine, and narrative flair set the blueprint for masterpieces like CD Projekt Red’s The Witcher 3 and Larian Studios' Baldur’s Gate 3, while inspiring other genres like sports simulation, racing, and turn-based strategy to adopt BioWare-style story mechanics.

articles.title: Way of the Warrior Kid - Official Trailer - IGN
articles.summary:
Every kid needs someone in their corner. Check out the trailer for Way of the Warrior Kid, an upcoming coming-of-age drama movie starring Chris Pratt, Jocko Willink, Jude Hill, Linda Cardellini, and Levi McConaughey. Middle school has been a nightmare for Marc, a good kid who is bullied and feels behind in everything. That changes when his Uncle Jake, an injured and decorated Navy SEAL, comes to spend the summer. To help Marc defend himself, Jake devises an ambitious program called "Operation Warrior Kid" based on his SEAL training to teach his nephew what real courage is and how to face down his own demons.

Way of the Warrior Kid is produced by David Ellison, Dana Goldberg, Don Granger, McG, Mary Viola, Chris Pratt, Ben Everard, Jocko Willink, and Bruce Wayne Gillies.Will Staples, Steven Bello, and Cliff Lanning serve as executive producers. It is written by Will Staples.Way of the Warrior Kid, directed by McG, premieres on Apple TV on November 25, 2026.
